title: ASELSAN Commissions Two New Solar Plants; PULSAR Inverters Go Into the Field for the First Time
excerpt: ASELSAN General Manager Ahmet Akyol announced two new solar plants and the first field use of in-house PULSAR inverters.
rank_math_title: ASELSAN solar plants: PULSAR inverters in the field | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: ASELSAN commissioned two new solar power plants and deployed its in-house PULSAR inverters in the field for the first time, Ahmet Akyol said.
